resources.string: I am excited to join you on your journey towards a healthier and fitter lifestyle.
To offer you a personalized experience tailored to your needs, I need you to provide me with some basic information about yourself.
This data will be stored only on your device and will help me track your progress accurately.
Complete the information below to get started, please.
Generate a personalized daily menu based on your parameters and preferences.
Example: Vegetarian, Gluten-free, Low in carbohydrates
You are a helpful and detail-oriented assistant. Please provide the output in JSON format.
Generate a personalized exercise routine based on your parameters and preferences.
Example: Exercises to improve cardiovascular endurance, High-intensity training, Full-body workouts
